info.name: Socialstats API
info.description:
API Access to Creator and Social Content Data

Enterprise API collection generated from docs/socialstats_openapi.yaml and live Rails Enterprise routes.
Set the `api_key` collection variable before sending authenticated requests. The collection uses the `apikey` header for authentication. OAuth callback/status endpoints may also support short-lived state-token access as documented.

Postman exports collections as JSON. This file uses the Postman Collection v2.1 schema.

variable.description: Set this to your Socialstats Enterprise API key. It is sent in the apikey header.
Use all or a comma-separated source list such as youtube,instagram,tiktok,facebook.
DONT BLINK Socialstats creator ID used by the examples.
Example creator source link used by link_request endpoints.

request.description:
Returns historic creator-level statistics filtered by source and date range. Set `with_aggregates=true` to include additional source aggregate fields where available. For per-post historic views, likes, comments, shares, saves, and reposts, use `/posts/historic_stats`.
Generated from docs/socialstats_openapi.yaml.

Creator-level endpoints support youtube, instagram, facebook, and tiktok. Public post-level content supports instagram, youtube, and tiktok. Authorized post-level content also supports facebook. Example: instagram,youtube,tiktok.
- socialstats_creator_id (required): The Socialstats ID of the creator being requested. Example: 0y6vlkgu.
- start_date (optional): Specifies the start date of the historic data being requested. Example: 2026-06-18.
- end_date (optional): Specifies the end date of the historic data being requested. Example: 2026-06-24.
- with_aggregates (optional): Includes aggregate values where available for historic source statistics. Example: true.
